posts.title: castlevania advance collection
posts.description: Castlevania Advance Collection is a remastered compilation of four of the released Castlevania games for the Gameboy Advance. Castlevania: Circle of Blood, Harmony of Dissonance, Aria of Sorrow, and Dracula X. The games focuses on the usual plot, defeat Dracula, explore his castle and defeat the bosses about sums it up. posts.title: megatagmension blanc and neptune vs zombies
posts.description: MegaTagmension Neptunia Blanc Vs Zombies is a spin off from the mainline Neptunia games. It focuses on the cast of the Neptunia games, Blanc and her friends at Gamicademy, who must fight zombies while shooting a movie. posts.title: nights of azure
posts.description: Nights Of Azure is a JRPG by Gust and Koei Tecmo. Arnice a half demon who must stop the Nightlord from creating an eternal night on the island of Ruswal. A saint must be sacrificed to stop the never ending darkness from permanently enveloping the island.
